title: Can I SURVIVE Crazyhouse Chess?
summary: chess.com Crazyhouse vs online humans (first opponent ~2200): captured pieces go to the capturer's hand and can be dropped on any empty square instead of moving. Tony loses several (including rematches), then wins game 5 and a later game with a smothered mate by dropping a captured knight.
rules: Captured enemy pieces switch colour and go to your pocket.
On your turn you may drop a pocket piece on any empty square instead of moving (pawns not on 1st/8th rank).
Promoted pieces revert to pawns when captured (standard crazyhouse).

board.theme_notes: chess.com board with pocket piece counters; thumbnail: smiling cartoon house icon with green/blue eyes, 'Crazyhouse?'
